# Lead Hub Build Brief
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Delivery Objective

Implement issue #36 (Security: Lower Password Requirements) in the existing Lead Hub authentication flow. The password policy must require at least 8 characters and at least 3 of 4 character types: uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character. Validation messages must identify unmet requirements.

## Authorization

- D-73 (Should Lead Hub lower the password policy minimum and character-type threshold?) is Made from requester authorization on 2026-09-14.
- CHG-50 (Lower Password Requirements) is Approved for local implementation and a reviewed PR to `staging`.
- ACT-71 (Implement and verify the password policy change from issue #36 (Security: Lower Password Requirements)) is In Progress.
- Production changes are not authorized.

## Approved Boundary

### Included

- Existing server-side password validation.
- User-facing password validation messages.
- Focused authentication tests for accepted and rejected boundaries.
- Regression evidence for unchanged password storage, hashing, reset, access-state, verification, rate-limit, and scheduling behavior.
- Safe synthetic-data screenshot evidence for the fix.

### Excluded

- Password hashing or storage format.
- Password reset and email delivery.
- Registration, approval, revocation, restoration, or role behavior.
- Login rate limiting or bot controls.
- Participant-data rules, external providers, deployment, staging configuration, and production configuration.
- Any unrelated source or documentation changes.

## Acceptance Result

The cycle passes only when all conditions in `stages/matic/02-plan-control/acceptance-matrix.md` pass:

- 8 characters are accepted at the minimum boundary and shorter passwords are rejected.
- Exactly 3 of 4 character types are accepted, and fewer than 3 are rejected.
- Validation messages explain length and character-type failures.
- No storage, hashing, reset, access-state, verification, rate-limit, or scheduling behavior changes.
- A safe screenshot contains synthetic data only.

## Delivery Path

```text
Define -> Design -> Build -> Reconcile -> Measure -> Learn -> Publish
```

The publication boundary is one PR from `matic/issue-36-lower-password-requirements` to `staging`, requesting `dennisatssd`. The related issue remains open until the exact PR is verified merged into `staging`.
